purpose: Define how one canonical relationship can appear across factual D4 reality and multiple D1-D11 analytical/project-symbolic projections without duplicating the relationship or turning uncertainty into fact.
core_rule: A relationship does not belong to exactly one dimension. The canonical edge remains one edge; D1-D11 describe different states, functions, histories, thresholds, recurrences, generative effects, transmissions, integrations or project-symbolic readings of that edge.
epistemic_firewall: Material facts, legal instruments, financial balances, treaties, observed exchanges and sourced institutional relations remain empirical records. Spiritual height, heaven/hell proximity, karmic polarity, light, attraction and other Potatoverse readings remain optional project interpretation and may not overwrite empirical fields.
visibility_rule: Visibility is epistemic, not spiritual altitude. A hidden or invisible relation is not automatically deep, corrupt, malicious or D1-D3. Its visibility state records what can be known and how.

visibility_states.public: The relation is openly documented and inspectable.
visibility_states.partially_public: The relation is established but important terms, counterparties or quantities are incomplete or redacted.
visibility_states.confidential_disclosed: A reliable source establishes that a non-public relation exists, while some details remain confidential.
visibility_states.inferred: The relation is a reasoned inference from observable evidence and must remain labeled as inference.
visibility_states.alleged_hidden: A source alleges a concealed relation but the Atlas does not treat it as established fact.
visibility_states.unknown: Visibility or existence cannot currently be resolved.

bond_formality.informal: Personal, social or customary relation without formal instrument.
bond_formality.customary: Repeated practice or norm creates a durable relation without a single governing contract.
bond_formality.contractual: A contract or comparable enforceable instrument defines material terms.
bond_formality.treaty: A treaty or formal interstate agreement institutionalizes the relation.
bond_formality.institutional: Membership, governance or standing institutional rules bind the actors.
bond_formality.constitutional: The relation is embedded in a constitutional or foundational legal order.

vertical_roles.1: Lock-in, near-terminal closure, relation with no modeled viable exit or revision pathway.
vertical_roles.2: Capture, recurrence, blocked exit, opaque circulation, adversarial orbit or disintegrating feedback.
vertical_roles.3: History, provenance, buried terms, accumulated memory, inherited obligation, path dependence and unresolved residue.
vertical_roles.4: Observable/material relation: instrument, payment, treaty, trade, ownership, communication, migration, event or other sourced fact.
vertical_roles.5: Threshold and terms: authorization, covenant/contract trigger, maturity, accession, default, settlement, refusal, release or other regime change.
vertical_roles.6: Recurrence with change: rollover, repeated cooperation, learning, renegotiation, escalation/de-escalation and measurable relational delta.
vertical_roles.7: Generative relation: reciprocal capacity, friendship/partnership that creates useful downstream capability, nourishment or future branches.
vertical_roles.8: Composition and durable alliance: institutions, federated systems, cultural rooms, shared infrastructure, mutual defense and differentiated coexistence.
vertical_roles.9: Relay and transmission: diplomacy, intelligence-sharing, standards, data, education, media, research, translation and message fidelity.
vertical_roles.10: Integrated system effect: collective capability, balance sheet, alliance architecture, network leverage, aggregate burden/capacity and system-level coordination.
vertical_roles.11: Meta-orientation: shared criteria, constitutional purpose, covenantal/project-symbolic orientation or system-wide objective used to evaluate lower projections.

loan_or_debt.reading: D4 records the instrument and balance; D3 preserves issuance/creditor history; D5 holds maturity, covenant, refinancing, default and settlement thresholds; D6 tracks rollover and changing terms; D10 aggregates portfolio/system exposure.
loan_or_debt.caution: Owing money is not automatically moral/spiritual descent. Distress, capture or repair are separate state variables.

treaty.reading: The signed instrument is D4; ratification/accession/withdrawal clauses are D5; durable institutional composition is D8; system-wide consequences can be D10.

alliance.reading: Observable commitments remain D4; entry/exit/activation conditions are D5; institutionalized cooperation and shared capability are D8; intelligence/diplomatic relay is D9; collective deterrence or integrated capacity is D10.
alliance.caution: Higher integration does not automatically mean morally good. Preserve coercion, asymmetry, agency and externalities.

friendship_or_trust.reading: Observed interaction remains D4; sustained reciprocal history is D6; demonstrated mutual generativity can project to D7; durable social/cultural composition can project to D8.
friendship_or_trust.caution: Do not infer friendship from mere proximity, alliance, shared ideology or repeated contact.

intelligence_or_information_sharing.reading: Documented exchange is D4; permissions/classification/access gates are D5; relay fidelity and mediation are D9; integrated information advantage can be D10.

ownership_or_control.reading: Ownership/control facts are D4, provenance chains are D3, change-of-control triggers are D5, governance composition can be D8, and consolidated control/system exposure can be D10.

trade_or_supply_dependency.reading: Flows and contracts are D4; tariffs/sanctions/thresholds are D5; changing dependence is D6; shared production systems are D8; systemic concentration/resilience is D10.

migration_or_diaspora.reading: Observed movement/population is D4; historical paths are D3; repeated waves/change are D6; durable communities/cultural rooms are D8; communication/remittance/knowledge relay can be D9; aggregate demographic/economic effects can be D10.

care_or_social_obligation.reading: Observable duty/service is D4; explicit commitment and release conditions are D5; reciprocal/autonomous capacity created by care can be D7; durable care institutions belong to D8.

capture_or_adversarial_loop.reading: Observable interactions remain D4; provenance and accumulated residue are D3; recurrence/blocked exit/capture is D2; a safe exit, settlement or boundary is D5.
capture_or_adversarial_loop.caution: D2 is a property of the relational regime, not a permanent label for a person, population, platform or territory.

cultural_affinity.reading: Language, surveys, migration and institutions provide D4 evidence; history is D3; change over time is D6; durable differentiated culture is D8; cultural transmission is D9.

relational_height_principle.meaning: Height represents the kind or maturity of relational organization being inspected, not social worth, holiness, GDP, military power or moral rank.
relational_height_principle.non_monotonic_rule: The same relation can have high institutional integration and severe asymmetry or harm. Therefore the Atlas must show multiple observables instead of one vertical goodness score.

hidden_relation_rules: Never infer a hidden alliance, debt, ownership chain or personal tie solely from symbolic similarity, co-occurrence or project mythology.
Render inferred and alleged-hidden relations differently from public/disclosed relations and expose the evidence basis on inspection.
A confidential but reliably disclosed relation can be highly institutionalized; secrecy does not imply D2.
Unknown counterparties should remain unknown rather than being filled by narrative inference.
Project-symbolic invisible ties belong in project_interpretation unless separately evidenced.

us_sovereign_debt_example.status: modeling example; values must come from dated official/validated datasets before display

projections.D3: issuance history, creditor composition history, refinancing path dependence
projections.D4: actual outstanding instruments, holders, currency, rates, maturity and cash flows
projections.D5: auction, maturity, refinancing, statutory/legal thresholds, payment/default/settlement events
projections.D6: rollover cycles and change in rates, duration, holder composition and burden
projections.D9: market-information and payment/settlement transmission where modeled
projections.D10: aggregate sovereign balance-sheet, interest burden, network exposure and macro-system consequences

us_sovereign_debt_example.firewall: No US public-debt value may be added to, converted into, or displayed as project-symbolic karmic debt.

implementation_guidance.edge_storage: Extend relational-edge-state records with visibility, bond, flow and vertical_projection while keeping empirical evidence and project interpretation separate.
implementation_guidance.map_behavior: Selecting an edge should eventually expose its D4 facts first and then let Axis navigation reveal other projections of the same edge.
implementation_guidance.trace_behavior: Trace should be able to filter by relationship family, visibility/evidence class, flow kind, direction, time and selected D-role.
implementation_guidance.visual_behavior: Use arrows/width/animation only when direction, amount/rate and time semantics are defined. Use dashed/faded styling for inferred/alleged relations rather than pretending precision.
implementation_guidance.metric_behavior: Never collapse reciprocity, institutionalization, asymmetry, recurrence, closure and generativity into one universal relation score.
